title: Molalla girl's team runs to win at The Bigfoot
excerpt: Molalla High’s girls cross country squad put together its best team outing of the season, taking the team title at The Bigfoot Classic, run on the rolling grass of Alderbrook […]
content:
Published 2:30 pm Thursday, October 22, 2026

Molalla High’s girls cross country squad put together its best team outing of the season, taking the team title at The Bigfoot Classic, run on the rolling grass of Alderbrook Golf Course.

The Indians were led by Ryn Grossnickle, who traversed the 5,000 meter course in a time of 21 minutes, 33.5 seconds, good enough for fourth overall.

But, she was backed by Keira Clark and Grace Ferlan, who rolled into the finish chute in sixth and seventh place, respectively. From there it was up to the squad’s fourth and fifth finishers to bring it home, something that Alia Banta (25th) and Aubrey Hodgson (34th) did quite nicely.

When the scores were tallied, Molalla had 65 points, easily outdistancing second place Astoria (83 points).

On the boys side, the Indians couldn’t quite add another team title to its 2026 season resume. Molalla scored 42 points, just three behind eventual winner Neah-Kah-Nie (39 points).

Nick Wood and Jake Kenton led the Indians, who put four runners in the top-10. Wood (3rd) and Kenton (4th) were followed by Tyler Kenton in eighth and Owen Marshall in ninth. Isaac Marshall was the fifth varsity running across the line in 18th spot.

Molalla will contest its Tri-Valley Conference Championship on Wednesday, Oct. 28, at Milo McIver State Park. .
